hasPart.name: What happened to collectors and investors who owned numismatic coins during President Roosevelt's 1933 gold confiscation order?
hasPart.text: What happened to collectors and investors who owned numismatic coins during President Roosevelt's 1933 gold confiscation order?

comment.text: When President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 6102 confiscating private gold ownership in 1933, collectors and investors who owned numismatic coins were exempt from surrender.

suggestedAnswer.text: They had to surrender all their coins

hasPart.name: Which gold bar size is considered the "central bank standard"?
hasPart.text: Which gold bar size is considered the "central bank standard"?

comment.text: 400-ounce bars are the central bank standard and the backbone of global gold reserves, representing the largest commonly traded gold bar size.

hasPart.name: What is the purity level of American Gold Eagle coins?
hasPart.text: What is the purity level of American Gold Eagle coins?

comment.text: American Gold Eagles are 22 karat (91.67% gold) and feature Augustus Saint-Gaudens' iconic Liberty design. They are the most popular gold coin in America.

hasPart.name: Which gold coin was the world's first modern gold bullion coin?
hasPart.text: Which gold coin was the world's first modern gold bullion coin?

comment.text: The South African Krugerrand was the world's first modern gold bullion coin (1967) and over 60 million ounces have been sold worldwide, making it the world's most widely held gold coin.

hasPart.name: What is the key difference between gold coins and gold rounds?
hasPart.text: What is the key difference between gold coins and gold rounds?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coins have government backing, rounds do not

comment.text: Gold rounds offer the appearance of coins without government backing, often featuring creative designs and lower premiums than official government-issued coins.

suggestedAnswer.text: Rounds are always smaller than coins

hasPart.name: What is a key benefit of fractional gold products?
hasPart.text: What is a key benefit of fractional gold products?

acceptedAnswer.text: They provide a lower entry point for new investors

comment.text: Fractional gold products make precious metals investing accessible to everyone, offering the same protection and growth potential with entry points as low as $200-$400.

suggestedAnswer.text: They have lower premiums than full ounces
They are easier to store than full ounces
They appreciate faster than full ounces

hasPart.name: Which professional grading service is mentioned as the industry leader with the highest premiums?
hasPart.text: Which professional grading service is mentioned as the industry leader with the highest premiums?

comment.text: PCGS (Professional Coin Grading Service) is mentioned as the industry leader with the highest premiums for certified gold coins.

hasPart.name: For a beginner portfolio under $10,000, what is the recommended allocation according to the content?
hasPart.text: For a beginner portfolio under $10,000, what is the recommended allocation according to the content?

comment.text: For beginners with under $10,000, the recommended allocation is 60% 1-ounce coins (American Eagles or Maple Leafs for liquidity), 30% fractional coins for flexibility, and 10% small bars for low premiums.

hasPart.name: True or False: Canadian Gold Maple Leafs were the world's first 99.99% pure gold bullion coin.
hasPart.text: True or False: Canadian Gold Maple Leafs were the world's first 99.99% pure gold bullion coin.

comment.text: Canadian Gold Maple Leafs were the world's first 99.99% pure gold bullion coin and feature advanced security including radial lines and micro-engraved laser marks.
